Sol xhigh OFFLINE code/runner worker; workspace /home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela. Root exclusively owns UART/USB/Windows/network/credentials/flash. No hardware, OS process queries, network or credential access; no new agents. Read rootREADME/instructions. All files created ONLY under backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/korvo-network-11ax-stop-diagnostic. Preserve existing/frozen source, receipts, traces and firmware. No builds/downloads/SDK or firmware changes.

Implement the smallest new diagnostic adapter justified by Astra review korvo-network-11ax-board-gate/data-blocker-next-step.md. Existing AX current-ap-ax-01 gate completed: protocol71/PHY6/PS0/auth3/DHCP pass, originalUDP RX30s no receiver CSV, TXskipped, full16MiB original restored Rootproof korvo-network-11ax-board-gate/root-first-board-restoration.json at12:32UTC. Prior warmupping0/3 doesn't gateUDP. Exact same AX kernel/AppFS/config reusable. No new reference-IDF rerun.

Need Root-executable bounded ONE-RX diagnostic using existing exercised AXgate/E95 installation, measurements, ownedJobPID cleanup, dualUARTlocks, original-only full16MiB restore, freshproof, recovery. No secondworkload/TX, noextra pings/parameter changes/retries/timeoutextensions. Workload original30s/1470B/40M=41943040bit/s/-C both/boardactual64000/hostdefault, samecurrentAP. After existing post-RX software/resource snapshot and verifiedhost+boardtraffic process cleanup, while sameBoardSession available, issue exactlyone normal `ifdown wlan0` with bounded existingcommandtimeout and collect complete s31_wifi_rx_counters("stop") block plus getterstatus/commandreturn. Stop snapshot happens before esp_wifi_stop, but softwarepurge precedes it; label late shutdown-boundary, notatomicendload. Whetherdata succeeds orfails, stopafteroneRX and collectdiagnostic; nevercountasthroughputacceptance. No manual physical intervention/reflash permission needed;Root onlyexecutesafterreview.

Companion read-only hostneighbor entry for actualDHCPboardIP using existingWindows invocation helper: one beforetraffic, one afterexit beforeifdown. Include actualinterfaceindex,peerIP,MAC,State. Noflush/staticneighbor/networkconfigchanges orpacket capture. Missingneighbor is meaningful; querytool/transportfailmustbe explicitinfrastructureerror, notfake missing. No secretslogged. Hosttools/credentials Rootpaths supplied as existingtools; don't create orinspect livefiles. Current interface22/IP192.168.1.29 but verify explicitargs/environment using existing mechanism, do notfake hardwareproof.

Reuse existing AXgate modules by imports/minimal hooks; don't fork wholeflash/test framework. Exact originalproof remains currentrunactualreadback, explicit nointerveningwrites Rootassertion; newrunnerrecover mustwork WITHOUT candidate/EXE/credentials/freshproof. Candidate hashes provided in AXgate stage. Unknowncleanupownership blocks UART/reset as existingcontract. If safely injectingstoprequires a small localized adapter, explain hooks; avoid longgeneralized framework. Preservefailed/incomplete evidence. Return success only indicates bounded capture+restoration, nevernewxTS pass; classifier retainsRXINCOMPLETE andstopgetter failures.

Delivery: concise README/handoff, dependencies/artifact manifest, minimal focused OFFLINE tests with hardware/Windows/serial/network blocked. Verify exactonedown/noTX, originalcommandunchanged, neighbor-missingvsqueryfailure, trafficcleanup ownership preventsstop/reset, stopfailure retainsoriginalrecovery, recovery independentofcandidate. Reuse fixtures where practical. Do not rehash gigantic246k-source inventories or rebuild; exactselectedpair/dependencies enough. No newly invented mandatoryuserapprovals. Root will inspect then execute. Read current Root review and implementation first to choose smallest changes. Use fresh outputrunpath below thisnewdirectory. Do not precreate/fake completedjournal/timestamps; test fixtures explicitlysynthetic and notcurrentproof. Existing fullreadback from latestAXrestore is currentonlyuntilnextflash.

I’ll read the Root instructions, Astra review, and existing AX runner, then add the smallest offline diagnostic adapter and focused tests under the new evidence directory. I won’t access hardware, Windows, network, credentials, or process state.
I’m applying the xTS board-evidence skill to preserve the existing restoration and classification contracts. This turn remains offline preparation; Root will review and execute the adapter.

The AX runner already provides staging, fresh-proof checks, owned-process cleanup, and original recovery. I’m checking the measurement loop for a narrow hook that can capture the second neighbor entry and one `ifdown` after RX cleanup, using the same BoardSession.

The narrow hook is BoardSession exit: by then the loop has saved the RX result, post-load snapshot, and final process check, while still holding both UART locks. I’ll collect the neighbor entry and single stop there, suppress TX and final quiet, and use a diagnostic-only review. The frozen NSH parser supports `$?`, so one `echo` after `ifdown` can record its return status.

The adapter hooks are in place. The first neighbor query runs before worker preparation, preserving the existing 15-second traffic gate. The second runs after verified traffic cleanup, followed by one `ifdown`; stop timeout, incomplete output, and getter failures are retained while original recovery proceeds. I’m adding synthetic offline tests now.

Eight offline tests pass, covering unchanged commands, one RX with no TX, missing-neighbor versus query-error handling, retained stop failures, and recovery without candidate inputs. I’m checking the remaining cleanup edge: unverified board traffic exit must also block stop and recovery UART/reset.

The adapter now blocks stop and recovery UART/reset when board traffic exit is unverified; inherited cleanup still checks host Job/PID ownership before any recovery lease. The final nine-test run is finishing, including candidate-independent recovery and rejection of an existing output path without changing its receipt. I’m packaging the handoff and manifests next.

Implemented the [adapter and Root handoff](/home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/korvo-network-11ax-stop-diagnostic/README.md), with dependency and artifact manifests.

Nine offline tests pass: one RX/one stop, no TX, neighbor error classification, cleanup guards, stop-failure preservation, and candidate-independent recovery.

No live execution occurred; no throughput or xTS acceptance is claimed.

Root review correction before any hardware execution: remove the newly added recovery UART lease guard that requires board_cleanup.exit_verified/board_all_iperf_absent. It can deadlock original firmware recovery precisely when this Root-owned test hangs or UART stops responding. Existing authorization permits automatic reset/flash; user cannot press buttons. The selected physical board and candidate test are already owned and locked by Root. Unknown HOST Job/PID/path/start-time ownership must still block reset, exactly as the exercised inherited runner. Do not weaken that existing check.

Keep the normal ifdown diagnostic conditional on verified host+board traffic exit: unverified board exit means skip the optional stop snapshot, record diagnostic incomplete. It must NOT block original-only recovery once owned host cleanup has succeeded. Reuse the inherited recovery path directly; remove the extra board-state wrapper rather than add an override switch/manual approval or emergency bypass. Candidate-independent --recover remains unchanged and must work without candidate/credentials/EXE/freshproof. Preserve all data/results, work only in this diagnostic directory, no hardware/Windows/network/process queries.

Update offline tests so unknown HOST ownership still blocks UART/reset; unverified BOARD exit skips ifdown but restores original after successful owned-host cleanup. This change is necessary to preserve automatic recovery and requires rerunning the focused suite only. Preserve the unexecuted old revision as a small local draft archive if useful; do not touch frozen dependencies or firmware. Update README/artifacts/validation with exact new hashes. No further source changes or new guard policies. Deliver corrected files and brief result; Root will then execute using latest real proof. Also ensure all JSON deliveries parse (Root checked current ones parse correctly).

I’ll remove the board-state recovery wrapper and use inherited recovery directly. The optional `ifdown` will still require verified host and board exit. I’ll update the affected test and documentation, rerun the focused suite, and refresh the manifests within this directory.

All nine focused tests pass. Unverified board exit now skips `ifdown`, records an incomplete diagnostic, and restores all original bytes after owned-host cleanup. Unknown host ownership still blocks recovery UART/reset. I’m refreshing the hashes and checking that every delivered JSON file parses.

Corrected [runner and handoff](/home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/korvo-network-11ax-stop-diagnostic/README.md).

Inherited recovery runs directly. Unverified board exit skips optional `ifdown` and permits original restoration after host cleanup. Unknown HOST ownership still blocks reset.

Nine offline tests pass; all six JSON deliveries parse. Hashes updated, prior draft archived. No live execution occurred.
